name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – Before § 1 – Am 3
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: -1a. Calls, meanwhile, for the budget’s redistributive function to be stepped up, providing support for efforts to achieve meaningful convergence in economic and social progress between Member States;
